question: In which of the following shooting events (in distance) did Simranpreet Kaur Brar win silver medal in the women’s category at ISSF World Cup 2025, Lima?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simranpreet Kaur Brar** is a noted Indian shooter who has represented India in various international shooting events.
 
• She won the **silver medal** in the **25m women's shooting event** at the **ISSF World Cup 2025**, which was held in **Lima, Peru**.
 
• The **25m shooting event** is one of the prominent categories in shooting competitions. It requires precision, focus, and technical expertise.
 
• In the ISSF World Cup, medals are awarded based on performance in individual events like **25m, 50m, 75m, and 100m shooting**.
 
• The achievement of Simranpreet Kaur Brar in this specific category highlights her exceptional skills and dedication to the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ISSF World Cup:**

 
 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)** organizes the ISSF World Cup annually, bringing together top shooters from across the globe.
 
• Events in the ISSF World Cup include categories based on distance and shooting equipment, such as **rifle, pistol, and shotgun**.
 
• The competition serves as a platform for shooters to qualify for the **Olympic Games** and other major international events.
 
• The 2025 edition was held in **Lima, Peru**, showcasing remarkable performances from athletes worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Events Categories:**
 
 
• The **25m event** is a pistol shooting category requiring shooters to hit targets from a distance of **25 meters**.
 
• The **50m event** is a rifle or pistol category that demands a higher level of precision due to the increased distance.
 
• The **75m and 100m events** are generally associated with rifle shooting and require advanced skills in long-range target shooting.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of Indian Shooters:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in shooting sports, with shooters like **Abhinav Bindra, Gagan Narang, and Manu Bhaker** earning international accolades.
 
• Simranpreet Kaur Brar's silver medal at the ISSF World Cup 2025 adds to India's growing legacy in the sport.
 
• The success of Indian shooters is supported by initiatives like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and specialized coaching facilities.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Shooting Sports:**
 
 
• Shooting sports are a test of **accuracy, focus, mental strength, and coordination**.
 
• They are widely recognized and celebrated in international competitions, including the **Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games**.
 
• The ISSF World Cup serves as a crucial platform for shooters to hone their skills and compete at the highest level.

• Indian shooters undergo rigorous training programs under the guidance of experienced coaches.
